# Qwen2.5-VL — MiMo-Embodied-7B, image file to logits

Generated by `../../../examples/refgen/qwen25vl_ref.py` from the authors' code (transformers 5.7.0
`modeling_qwen2_5_vl`, torch 2.11.0, CPU, eager) on `XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-Embodied-7B` snapshot
`6857af64…`. Checked by `scripts/vl_conformance.sh <checkpoint-dir> mimo-embodied-7b.json.gz`.

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `probe.ppm` | the image, 224x140 — already a multiple of 28 on both sides, so neither processor resamples it and the pixel check isolates the MODEL, not two bicubic filters (the resampler is checked separately, `../qwen3vl_preproc`) |
| `mimo-embodied-7b.json.gz` | prompt ids and token types (the authors' processor and chat template), patch grid, window order, mRoPE positions; per stage — pixels, patch embedding, vision blocks 0/7/8/31, the merger before and after its un-permutation — per-row sum and sum of squares plus 24 sampled columns; logits at all 83 positions (top-10, 128 sampled ids, row sum and sum of squares). Everything twice: float32, and float64 (`float64`) — the noise floor the gate measures against |
| `mimo-embodied-7b.greedy.json` | a 64-token greedy continuation and the authors' argmax at every step of it (one teacher-forced forward), with the top-1/top-2 margins; the smallest is 0.032 |

⛔ Why float64 is in the fixture: from vision block 17 on a few tokens carry massive activations (one
channel reaches 5e4) produced by cancelling sums, and the authors' own float32 run is 7e-4 (sum of
squares) from float64 there. A float32 reference cannot arbitrate below that; the gate asks whether
Ferric is as close to float64 as the authors' float32 run is (within 4x).

⚠ Not pure float64: the authors' code casts to float32 inside every RMSNorm, the vision rope, the
attention softmax and the text rope angles, and those casts are kept.

The reference harness is itself checked before every fixture is written (`--selftest`): the streamed
path reproduces the authors' whole-model `forward` on a tiny random configuration bit for bit, and a
wrong position rule makes that check refuse.

`probe.ppm` is a centre crop, resized, of `assets/demo.jpg` from the XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-Embodied-7B
repository — Copyright (C) 2025 Xiaomi Corporation, MIT License.
